headline: Udupi reports 267 malnourished children under six; anaemia affects 50% of pregnant women
summary: Udupi district has 267 malnourished children below the age of six. A community-based study found that 50.14% of pregnant women in Udupi were anaemic during 2005-2006, with higher rates among young women, those in low socioeconomic groups, and women with short pregnancy intervals and higher parity. Child marriages persist despite awareness campaigns, with 12 cases reported in Mangaluru and Udupi districts over five years. Local authorities have launched campaigns to eliminate child marriages, emphasizing their negative impact on girls' physical, psychological growth, and education.
